title: Weigh the Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber: Antechamber Seal
description: Weigh the Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber: Antechamber Seal is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Sun-Scale Verdict Descent through The Sun-Scale Gate (Stable Gate under Ma’at strain). One selected deity from Aten Ra, Sutekh, Iset, Amunet enters; this beat spotlights Aten Ra as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the pre boss step at Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber, using sacred judgment temple-road descent pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use Aten sun-discs with life-giving hand-rays, electrum collars, nemes-like light mantles, faience turquoise and lapis inlays, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper, scarab engines, Ma’at feather geometry, solar barque arcs, pylon harnesses, lion/cobra/falcon/jackal threshold masks, lotus-papyrus river courts, and white-gold noon light..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Sun-Scale Verdict Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber and reveals: How Khepri dawn loops restore both allies and enemies. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber configured as a pre boss space inside sacred judgment temple-road descent; source-culture appearance layer: sun-scale courts, pylon shadow lanes, river-light channels, Khepri dawn engines, Ma’at seal platforms, desert storm edges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Ma’at was-sceptre blades, electrum wesekh source-plates, Khepri scarab cores, Uraeus counter-edict silhouettes
